description: This PHP class 'TerminationReasonController' extends an abstract Vue controller and manages termination reasons for an HRM system. It initializes a service, retrieves reasons in use, and sets up a Vue component with relevant properties for rendering.

classes.name: TerminationReasonController
classes.description: Controller managing termination reason configurations, extending Vue controller functionalities.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonService
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the TerminationReasonConfigurationService instance for accessing termination reason data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with termination reasons data before rendering.
